0022600153.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-1) are on the road for their sixth game of the season, sitting 1st in the Northwest and 3rd in the West, but they are on a one-game losing streak and are 1-1 away from home. They are without Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back) and Thomas Sorber (knee). The Houston Rockets (5-1) are 2nd in the Southwest, half a game back, and also on a one-game losing streak, with a 2-0 home record, while missing Fred VanVleet (knee), Reed Sheppard (back) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Thunder won their 2025-26 season series 2-1, though the most recent meeting, on February 7, 2026 in Oklahoma City, ended with the Thunder losing 112-106.
